column1: # Diyanet's European method (since 1 Jan 2023): namazvakitleri.diyanet.gov.tr city tables, restricted:
# archive only. The first column is İmsak, both the Fajr start and the end of eating (F+E).
# Each city is its own point table (ruling R44), checked at its unit's point. The twelve of Task 7b
# (Sarajevo to Oslo) are held in two captures: the research's of 25/26 Sep 2026 (that month to 25/26
# Oct, and all of 2027) and the monitor's of 28 Sep 2026 (29 Sep – 29 Oct 2026, and all of 2027;
# identical on every day both hold). The monitor's captures are split=test throughout: they add the
# four days after the clock change of 25 Oct 2026, which no research capture holds, and the monitor
# round found the first curves a minute early there (brief D); the curves' derivation was rebuilt on
# them. North of 44.5° each city's Fajr, Isha and end of eating follow depression curves derived from
# every held row of its own table (DiyanetEuropeCurves, tools/timetables' generateDiyanetEuropeCurves),
# so those three columns are fitted on both captures, not held out; the other columns' margins are
# fitted on six cities spread from south to north (Sarajevo, Zürich, München, Paris, Berlin,
# Stockholm) and held out on every other city.
# The monitor round added twenty-one more cities from the monitor's captures, each its own point
# table with its own curves, held out for the plain columns' margins: seven the cautious entries of
# France, Belgium, Sweden–Denmark–Finland and Norway lean on (Lyon, Lille, Gent, Antwerpen,
# Copenhagen — also the research's capture of 26 Sep 2026 — Helsinki and Trondheim, brief D step b),
# and fourteen Nordic ones from Malmö to Luleå (55.6–65.6° N, step c, fetched 29 Sep 2026). Diyanet's
# Nordic tables hold the printed day between five and nineteen hours around Dhuhr: the five-hour
# winter floor is the European method's own rule now (TimetableMethod.dayAroundDhuhrMinutes); the
# nineteen-hour summer cap, under which Diyanet prints sunrise after the sun's and Maghrib before the
# sunset north of about 60°, the app does not follow (the sun's own, the safe side; from Umeå north
# its Fajr and Isha then fall outside the day the sun allows and are declared, rulings R90 and
# DayComputer's point 9). Four polar tables (Rovaniemi, Bodø, Kiruna, Tromsø) are held as evidence
# only, since their polar days need the engine's polar path: proof/7b-turkiye-balkans-russia.md, the
# edge's section, gives their measure and what is not claimed there.
# The monitor's captures are read from copies pinned as they were (archive/tables/pinned/tr-diyanet-europe/<date>/),
# since the monitor's own files grow with each fetch: 2026-09-28 holds the captures of 28 and 29 Sep 2026. The
# monitor's capture of 2 Oct 2026 (2026-10-02/) refreshed nineteen of the cities (29 Sep – 1 Nov 2026 and all of
# 2027, the same minutes as before on every day both hold): a row each, held out, at the same units; it adds
# 30 October – 1 November 2026. The other eighteen were not refetched and add nothing.
